description: This file defines a public API wrapper for fetching active user trends based on different time buckets. It exports a function that maps UI bucket terms to backend granularity and forwards the request to an external API method.

methods.name: fetchActiveUsersByBucket(bucket, params = {})
methods.description: Fetches active user data grouped by the specified time bucket ('daily', 'weekly', or 'monthly') by forwarding the request to the external API with appropriately mapped granularity.
